questions.question: What does Tom do after school?
Choose the correct sentence in the present simple:
In English, we usually put the adjective before the noun (for example: a big house).
The sentence 'I am 12 years old.' is correct in English.
Pick the correct translation of "Je fais mes devoirs tous les soirs".
choices: I do my homework every evening.
I make my homework every evening.
I am doing my homework every evening yesterday.
I does my homework every evening.
